title: Agent invocation work notification v1
description: Content-free notification that one queued Agent Invocation is ready for an Agent Workload, published at least once to the agent work queue (message id invocationId:readyOccurrence). Possession of this message confers no authority: the Agent Workload must claim the invocation through the platform API. Additional properties are refused, so no content (question, advice, history, scope, credentials, or URLs) can be added.

readyOccurrence.description: Incremented each time the invocation becomes queued; part of the message id.
